conventions: TypeScript + React test file under packages/excalidraw/tests, run by Vitest with jsdom; describe/it/expect are globals, vi is imported from "vitest".

Formatting is Prettier through eslint-plugin-prettier (@excalidraw/prettier-config: 80-column lines, double quotes, trailing commas, 2-space indent); an import list longer than 80 columns is broken one name per line.

Import groups are separated by blank lines in eslint import/order: external libs, then @excalidraw/common, then @excalidraw/element, then relative imports; names inside one import are sorted as the existing line has them.
Use the repo's helpers only: API (tests/helpers/api.ts) for scene and state, Keyboard/Pointer/UI (tests/helpers/ui.ts) for input, act/fireEvent/waitFor/GlobalTestState from ./test-utils.
Change only the lines the sites name; every other line of pages.test.tsx stays byte-for-byte as it is.
No assertion is deleted, loosened to a bound or made tautological, and no it.skip, it.todo or .only is introduced.

decisions.topic: How the undo test records its moves
decisions.choice: Seed r1 and r2 with one API.updateScene({ elements: [r1, r2], captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY }) and make each move one API.updateScene whose elements list holds both rectangles in the order [r1, r2], the moved one replaced by newElementWith(API.getElement(el), { x: 1 }), with captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY.
rejected: Keyboard.keyPress(KEYS.ARROW_RIGHT) nudges: App never captures a nudge, so the undo stack stays empty
Passing only the moved element to updateScene: updateScene replaces all scene elements, so the other rectangle would be dropped from the scene
A Pointer drag: works, but needs coordinates and selection state the updateScene form does not
decisions.reason: updateScene with IMMEDIATELY is the documented captured path (history.test.tsx uses it) and the brief confirmed it gives one undo step per move on its page.

decisions.topic: When the search test presses Enter
decisions.choice: fireEvent.keyDown(searchInput, { key: KEYS.ENTER }) runs after the waitFor that sees searchMatches.matches.length === 1 and before the waitFor on activePageId.
rejected: Pressing Enter right after updateTextEditor: the search is debounced and the Enter handler ignores the key while there are no match items
decisions.reason: The SearchMenu Enter handler only calls goToNextItem when match items exist, and focusing that match is what switches the page.

decisions.choice: The tab menu trigger is [data-testid='pages-menu-trigger'] and the delete item is [data-testid='page-menu-delete'], as PagesTabBar.tsx renders them.
decisions.reason: These are the ids the component has; the old ids match nothing.

units.behaviour: Correct the four defects in pages.test.tsx: record the undo test's seed and moves as captured updates, use the component's real menu test ids, and press Enter in the search input so the cross-page match is focused.
rules: 1. The @excalidraw/element import gains CaptureUpdateAction and newElementWith beside DEFAULT_PAGE_ID and getVisiblePages, sorted as CaptureUpdateAction, DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, getVisiblePages, newElementWith, broken one name per line since it exceeds 80 columns; Keyboard and KEYS stay imported because undo(), the select-all test, the rename test and the search test still use them.
2. openTabMenu queries [data-testid='pages-menu-trigger']; its not-null expectation and click stay.
3. Both lookups in 'deletes a page via the menu' query [data-testid='page-menu-delete']; the disabled-while-single-page assertion and every later assertion stay unchanged.
4. In 'keeps undo on its page' the seed is API.updateScene({ elements: [r1, r2], captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY }) in place of API.setElements([r1, r2]).

5. The default-page move replaces API.setSelectedElements([r1]) and the arrow key press with API.updateScene({ elements: [newElementWith(API.getElement(r1), { x: 1 }), API.getElement(r2)], captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY }); the following expect(API.getElement(r1).x).toBe(1) stays.

6. The page-2 move replaces API.setSelectedElements([API.getElement(r2)]) and the arrow key press with API.updateScene({ elements: [API.getElement(r1), newElementWith(API.getElement(r2), { x: 1 })], captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY }); the following expect(API.getElement(r2).x).toBe(1) stays.
7. Both updateScene move calls pass both rectangles in the order [r1, r2], because updateScene replaces every scene element and a missing rectangle would be removed.
8. The five post-undo assertions (r1.x 0, r2.x 1, activePageId DEFAULT_PAGE_ID; r2.x 0, activePageId p2Id) and both undo() calls and switchPage calls stay exactly as they are.

9. In 'finds text on another page and switches to it', fireEvent.keyDown(searchInput, { key: KEYS.ENTER }); is inserted after the waitFor that expects searchMatches.matches.length to be 1 and before the waitFor on activePageId.
10. In 'lets view mode switch but not edit pages' the absence assertion queries [data-testid='pages-menu-trigger'] and still expects null.

sites.rule: Rule 1: multi-line import of CaptureUpdateAction, DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, getVisiblePages, newElementWith from "@excalidraw/element".
Rule 2: same line with the id pages-menu-trigger.
Rule 3: same line with the id page-menu-delete.
Rule 3: same line with the id page-menu-delete.
Rule 4: captured seed via API.updateScene with CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY.
Rules 5 and 7: one captured API.updateScene moving r1 to x 1, both rectangles passed.
Rules 6 and 7: one captured API.updateScene moving r2 to x 1, both rectangles passed.
Rule 9: fireEvent.keyDown(searchInput, { key: KEYS.ENTER }); on its own line, indented like the surrounding statements.
Rule 10: same assertion with the id pages-menu-trigger.

style_from.reason: Shows API.updateScene with newElementWith(...) elements and CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY as this repo writes it.

tests.name: keeps undo on its page
tests.given: r1 on the default page and r2 on page 2 seeded by one captured update, then each moved to x 1 by its own captured update on its page
tests.expect: one undo on the default page gives r1.x 0, r2.x 1, activePageId default; one undo on page 2 gives r2.x 0, activePageId page 2

tests.name: deletes a page via the menu
tests.given: the menu opened through pages-menu-trigger, first with one page, then with a second page holding a rectangle
tests.expect: page-menu-delete is disabled with one page; clicking it with two leaves one visible page, the rectangle isDeleted, and the default page active

tests.name: finds text on another page and switches to it
tests.given: a text 'pipeline' on page 2, the search typed while the default page is active, then Enter pressed in the search input
tests.expect: one search match and activePageId switches to page 2

tests.name: lets view mode switch but not edit pages
tests.given: two pages and view mode on
tests.expect: no add button and no pages-menu-trigger, while tab clicks still switch pages
